jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
jobs.description_excerpt: About Aerobotics Aerobotics is a Vision AI company helping fruit producers get more from every harvest. Our models are trained on the world's largest fruit dataset, creating a flywheel that continuously improves the product for our customers. We started with fruit sizing and expanded into forecasting and grading, and we're now developing full yield estimation. Our platform delivers accurate, transparent insights across the fruit supply chain. To date, we've analysed over 400 million trees from the sky, and more than 300 million fruit up close, helping farmers make critical operational and agricultural decisions that maximise yield and efficiency. Our global team of 50+ professionals is headquartered in Cape Town, with commercial teams in the USA, Australia, Europe, and South America.
